metrics.blocking_finding: SUPERVISION IS THE BINDING CONSTRAINT and it is far tighter than this arc assumed. The TRAIN ground truth is sparsely annotated: 5935 GT nodes against 186803 predicted nodes (3.2%). Matching is NOT the problem -- 99.1% of GT nodes matched. Divisions: 12 total; 7 mothers across the six training movies of which only 5 have mother AND both daughters matched; 5 across the two held-out movies of which 4 are complete. The division head -- the entire mechanism of the exp067 hypothesis -- would be fit on 5 positives and evaluated on 4. The link head has ~3.6k positives and is fine, but a link-only model is an edge intervention, the class this project has repeatedly measured null.
